sources.title: GitHub - krea-ai/krea-2: Official inference code for Krea 2
sources.snippet: Krea 2 - an image generation model from Krea AI. API Docs • Hugging Face (RAW) • Hugging Face (TURBO) • Technical Blog This is the official repository for the open version of Krea 2, an image model trained from scratch focused on creative and stylistic exploration. The repository contains inference code and instructions to run the model.

sources.title: Krea 2: AI Image Foundation Model & Style Control
sources.snippet: Create expressive AI images with Krea 2, Krea AI's in-house foundation model for aesthetic diversity, style control, moodboards, and creative workflows.

sources.title: Krea 2 - Krea
sources.snippet: Krea 2 (K2) is Krea's first image foundation model built in house from scratch and designed around aesthetics and creative control rather than only prompt accuracy. The model is positioned as a creative medium for generating the first image: a starting point for exploration, style discovery, and visual direction setting across artistic, illustrative, photographic, and experimental outputs.
